title: projections/<plan-id>/baselines/<id>.json
description: A saved projection (PROGRESS.md, Baselines): the outputs of a plan's run as you saw them, which recalculating later with newer code or data wouldn't give. Saved automatically at the first check-in of each year for the main plan, or by hand. The file name is its ID, normally the date it was created; a second one on the same day gets -2. Values are in money of the start date, in the library's base currency. These files aren't deleted when a plan changes or is deleted: they're a record of the past. Baselines made by test versions may also hold taxParameters, and their headline fiProgress, which are kept as they are.

kind.description: yearly (saved at the year's first check-in), manual (saved by hand), or past (added afterwards for a day in the past: what you planned then, from your plan assets that day; its start is that day).

label.description: A name given when saved by hand, e.g. "Before part-time".

engine.description: The planner's version that made it, e.g. 2.0.0.

accounts.description: The accounts the plan counted, so your actual line can be drawn over the same accounts.

plan.description: A full copy of the plan as it was.
plan.$comment: As written at the time, in the plan format of that version: not checked against today's plan schema.

start.description: Where the projection started: the check-in date and the plan assets on it.

years.description: One row per year up to the plan's end age: the deterministic run (expected) and the Monte Carlo percentiles at year-end. Months between year-ends are interpolated.

savings.description: The savings the plan expected that year.
